label: Über Gewißheit §151: Moore does not know what he claims to know, but it stands fast for him as for…
paraphrase: Über Gewißheit §151: Moore does not know what he claims to know (that here is a hand, that the earth existed long before his birth), but it stands fast for him as for Wittgenstein; regarding it as fixed belongs to the method of our doubting and inquiring.
